title: Can Occupational Therapy help my child with autism cope with sensory stimulation?
metaTitle: Sensory Integration in Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network can help your child with autism to cope better with sensory stimulation. Our therapists are experts in sensory integration strategies.
html: Absolutely, yes! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we have a team of trained occupational therapists who specialises in sensory integration strategies. They utilise a variety of therapeutic activities to help children with autism better understand, process, and respond positively to sensory stimuli.
